summary.one_line: Bank player documentation remains accurate after the dynamic test-address correction; no fresh live launch is claimed.

purpose.evidence: Read README.md, the only changed Markdown path, against mod.json, build-player.py, CMake and bank_launcher.cpp. It now explains a prospective player EXE+H5U package while preserving developer build/rebuild/removal guidance. It says the package is being prepared for Releases, not already stable or live accepted.

structure.evidence: RU and EN distinguish player setup/use/remove from developer source build, --check and mechanism details. Player steps keep the EXE/H5U pair together; developer steps build the H5U, derive a generated native payload header, compile/test x86 and copy the matching H5U beside the EXE. The corrected README commands use the actual sandbox output under H5_WORKSPACE/.local/test-state.

specificity.evidence: The pinned devkit Workshop with --sandbox writes army-reference.h5u under .local/test-state, and final README passes that path to scripts/build-player.py and Copy-Item. build-player freezes routes, SHA-256 and validated relocations into bank_payload.hpp; CMake requires that generated header before compiling. The EXE verifies four game hashes plus its matching neighboring H5U and refuses to overwrite a different UserMODs/workshop-army-reference.h5u. --check returns before copying or CreateProcess.

reproducibility.evidence: Parent reports six isolated checks passed and production --check accepted the supported game/H5U pair without launching. The extracted Unicode-path candidate ZIP passed --check with PATH limited to Windows system directories and no H5/Python environment. The final selector test now allocates its own disposable page and supplies its address to InstallSelector, avoiding fixed-address collisions; six checks and real-payload CTest/check passed in the same environment. README states no fresh live acceptance of the new launcher; I did not start a game. Reviewed exact HEAD 53f97fa.

evidence.evidence: Current source shows shared devkit/player_launch.hpp for file picker/hash/closed-game checks, mod-specific InstallPackage with fail-if-exists and post-copy hash, suspended CreateProcess/selector install, and cleanup limited to its new child on setup failure. Final InstallSelector signature accepts a test hookAddress but defaults to the original entry for production; bank_selector_test uses a dynamically allocated own page, and the fixed-base test linker override was removed. README discloses possible H5U residue after launch error and distinguishes isolated checks from live acceptance. Parent supplied candidate-package and pinned-game --check results; I did not inspect private game/profile contents.

applicability.evidence: README scopes the package to the pinned Universe build and says no bundled game files, no Python/Git/devkit for a compiled player package, no confirmed combined use with predictor, and no complete all-bank visual coverage. It distinguishes possible guard references from actual hidden selected guards. The native installer replaces the earlier devkit-only diagnostic launch only for this new candidate, without promoting the historical imp-cache test into fresh player-launch validation.

translations.evidence: RU and EN README agree on pending Releases package, source ZIP not installer, Heroes5BankReference folder beside bin, EXE/H5U pair, file picker, no foreign H5U overwrite, game-file preservation, removal, pinned devkit 587e09c, six no-game checks and no fresh live acceptance. EN points to shared PowerShell build commands and states the same corrected test-state artifact path through that block. No material contradiction found.

maintenance.evidence: The mod pins shared devkit as a submodule; generated payload/header and build outputs stay under .local, and CMake refuses a missing generated header. README says recipe edits require rebuilding H5U, header and EXE because package SHA is compiled into the launcher. Final HEAD 53f97fa changes test address plumbing only: production default remains pinned entry and no user instruction changes. review:info lists only README.md for the cumulative bank diff; no source file was edited by this reviewer.
